description: First original anime fighter for deformation tests. This recipe is not a generated asset.

appearance.style: Original adult anime martial artist, short hair, teal and charcoal sportswear
appearance.pose: Symmetric neutral T-pose; straight separated arms, separated fingers, feet apart
appearance.clothing: Fitted short jacket, trousers, fingerless gloves, short boots
appearance.reason: Start with visible shoulder, hip and knee articulation; compare long clothing later.

generation_body.prompt: A single original adult anime martial artist for a 3D fighting game, full body, short dark hair, expressive face, teal fitted short sports jacket, charcoal trousers, fingerless gloves and short boots. Symmetric neutral T-pose, arms straight sideways, palms down, fingers separated, feet shoulder-width apart. Athletic believable proportions, clearly separated limbs, clean shoulder and hip topology, opaque cel-friendly base colors, no background or pedestal. Intended character height 1.72 meters.
generation_body.negative_prompt: long skirt, cape, flowing coat, long hair, weapons, props, pedestal, action pose, bent arms, crossed legs, fused limbs, fused fingers, extra limbs, multiple characters, text, logos, baked hard shadows

tripo.note: spec=vrm selects skeleton naming; inspect whether the actual output has VRMC_vrm metadata. Do not merely rename GLB to VRM. No credentials or paid execution are included here.
